current_processing_date: The current system date when the processing or rule engine runs
system_base_currency: The default currency of the accounting system
invoice_number: Unique identifier present on the invoice face
invoice_date: Date of issuance printed on the invoice
grand_total_amount: Total monetary value of the invoice including all taxes
invoice_unit_rate: Unit price of an item as stated on the invoice
line_item_quantity: Quantity of a specific item on the invoice
qr_code_present: Boolean flag indicating presence of a valid e-invoice QR code
po_number: Reference number of the associated purchase order
po_amount: Total monetary value of the purchase order
po_type: Categorization of PO (e.g., goods-based or services-based)
po_unit_rate: Unit price of an item on the purchase order
po_line_item_quantity: Quantity of a specific item on the purchase order
grn_number: Reference number of the Goods Receipt Note (GRN)
grn_date: Date the goods were received as per the GRN
grn_quantity: Quantity of goods received as per the GRN
vendor_gstin: GST identification number of the vendor
vendor_pan: Permanent Account Number of the vendor
buyer_gstin: GST identification number of the purchasing company (buyer)
vendor_on_watchlist: Boolean flag indicating if the vendor is on an internal compliance or watch list
